notes: The model origin is the palm; the wrist sits behind the origin.
wrist_to_palm_offset is reference data for converting a weapon wrist bone (Bip01 R/L Hand) to the palm frame. It is never used as the model origin.
The runtime visual anchor target is the OpenXR grip pose origin, which must coincide with the hand palm bone within 0.1u.
Axes follow the GoldSrc hand convention validated by scripts/check_hand_asset.py: fingers +X, right palm inward +Y, left palm inward -Y, thumb +Z.
